messages.author: 4b4a7b00c1dd09c7
messages.subject: Re: Distance 6.0 R2 in Windows 7
parts:
Hi Greg, List,

This is the first report I've had of any problems running Distance 6.0
Release 2 under Windows 7. I've been doing this ever since W7 came out,
without problems. However, several of the components that Distance uses
are not officially supported in Windows 7 and, since the language that
the Distance interface is written in (Visual Basic 6) is now very
outdated, it is unlikely they will ever be. Hence, it may be that there
are problems under some configurations. Please can anyone who is having
problems with with Distance under Windows 7 please email me, saying:
- what the problems are
- what hardware you are using (including display adapter)
- exactly which version of Windows 7 you are using

Greg, let's continue this conversation off the list, but I wonder if
you've tried turning off some of the graphics acceleration?

Cheers to all, - Len Thomas

--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator, Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Environmental and Ecological Modelling

messages.author: 9237fe2e8425bbde
messages.subject: Re: Distance 6.0 R2 in Windows 7
parts:
List, Len,

After reinstalling Distance, trying various compatibility modes and fiddling
with various graphics settings, I was unable to get Distance to display
properly in my user account in Windows 7. However, during this, I happened
to open Distance in the Admin account on my computer and found that it
displays perfectly. I'm at a loss to explain why this works and what
setting or other configuration may be causing my problem, but it is a viable
work-around. It sounds like most (all?) other people using Distance 6.0 R2
on Windows 7 do so without issue. Len asks that anyone else experiencing
this problem contact him, and if you find the cause, I would also appreciate
hearing about it.

Thanks,

Greg Levandoski
